reads.stopped_at: The programme lets you inspect the workshop format and decide whether this is a creative weekend activity you’d like to explore further.
reads.what_it_sells: A beginner, instructor-led hand-building pottery workshop that could be a creative weekend activity, with clay and tools included and finished pieces collected after firing.
reads.relevance_feedback: The profile establishes that I am a local adult interested in trying a creative weekend activity, and the email offers a beginner pottery workshop as exactly that kind of option. The email additionally presents hand building, rather than wheel pottery, as the specific format; whether I prefer that format is unknown. The date, location details, duration, and price are also unknown.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I am interested in trying a creative weekend activity.
Email-only: I may be interested specifically in hand-building pottery.
Email-only: I need the distinction between hand building and a pottery-wheel session clarified.
Email-only: I am willing and able to collect finished pieces from ClayRoom after firing.
reads.problem_now: There is no urgent problem to solve. The offer is relevant to an established leisure interest, but the email gives me no timing or availability reason to investigate it this Tuesday morning.
reads.biggest_doubt: I cannot quickly judge whether the workshop fits my weekend because the email does not state the price, duration, available dates, or where ClayRoom is.
reads.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me the price, workshop duration, nearest available weekend date, and location.
fixes: Rewrite “The programme lets you inspect the workshop format and decide whether this is a creative weekend activity you’d like to explore further.” as a compact practical summary giving the price, duration, location, and next available weekend date.
Rewrite “After firing, finished pieces are collected from ClayRoom.” to state how long firing takes and when collection is normally available.
Replace “View the workshop programme →” with a CTA that identifies what I will see, such as “See dates, price and workshop details →”.
